test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means 'A is the sister of B'.

A & B means 'A is the brother of B'.

A # B means 'A is the wife of B'.

A ^ B means 'A is the mother of B'

A + B means 'A is the father of B'.

If A + G & I + R @ S @ T # U & V, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: I is the father-in-law of U.
A is the maternal grandfather of T.
G is the brother of I.
R is the paternal granddaughter of A.

solution:

Statement : **A + G & I + R @ S @ T # U & V**

So, according to the given symbols :​

 
• A + G → A is the father of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b24aa7abbe7238dd713a4e462f05d102794a67865a647b9863c6f4badacadca0.png] ​

 
• G & I → G is the brother of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c52ee1ebc7cd8f9d83041de3fc846c2d00ca7b02427ca3b0349dd1f0562ea4db.png] ​

 
• I + R → I is father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243e0f4fef547de00e0aec63e0c40fa3b408ef8c2bf1aec9a7ba508768fe851c.png] ​

 
• R @ S → R is he sister of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17ea99181ecb148fe44a2cd505b6439622fdb10e73c62a28bfc5ca28319cefa4.png] ​

 
• S @ T → S is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93fbaa52fe5f602755b8fc30857190db939a8e46d5c2e0f8123a7cb292703bf5.png] ​

 
• T # U → T is the wife of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3bdcbbcbae23a5e65f34a8c6f9c33b3bce7546de489154109cf9d248120da6.png] ​

 
• U & V → U is the brother of V.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/207bbf25bce1468218f2772b930659854e1e7daf0245269e9ea7ccfc96a7c153.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : I is the father-in-law of U → Correct 
 
• Option - (2) : A is the maternal grandfather of T → **Incorrect**
 
• Option - (3) : G is the brother of I → Correct
 
• Option - (4) : R is the paternal granddaughter of A → Correct

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
